Name: Vulpix Pokemon as Cat
Author: Halfwheat
Description:
This mod changes your cat to a Vulpix. Sprites taken from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time/Darkness. I do not have the spriting ability to make these myself :P

Check out my profile for more Pokemon mods!

INSTALLATION

1. Go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals (similar path for Mac/Linux) and make a backup of your files.

2. Copy and paste the cat.xnb file from the download into this Animals folder.

3. Overwrite the file when prompted and you're good to go!

Let me know if anyone is having any problems with the sprite or if there are any stray pixels!

OTHER MODS USED IN THIS IMAGE
Currently using GetDressed, Ali's Enchanted Garden Buildings, alicedafox's New Shirts and 2 New Skirts, and alicedafox's hairstyles.
